title: KICKA Event
description: Schema for a single match event in the KICKA standard v0.1

match_id.description: Identifier of the match this event belongs to

team_id.description: Identifier of the team performing the event

player_id.description: Identifier of the player performing the event

type.description: Event type, e.g. pass, shot, goal, tackle, foul

subtype.description: Optional refinement of the event type, e.g. through_ball for pass

timestamp.description: Seconds elapsed since the start of the period

period.description: Match period (1 = first half, 2 = second half, 3/4 = extra time, 5 = penalties)

location.description: Pitch coordinates where the event occurred

end_location.description: Pitch coordinates where the event concluded, if applicable

outcome.description: Result of the event, e.g. complete, incomplete, on_target, blocked

related_event_id.description: Identifier of a related event, e.g. the pass leading to a shot

metadata.description: Additional freeform attributes specific to the event type
